title: 第一卷 第23章 一鸣惊人第一卷 第24章 意外发现
slug: 乱世加点从猎户到武圣只杀不赦
content_zh:
“什么？居然是三发连射！？”
“这是什么怪物？”
“还有这种箭术？”
围观众人瞬间哗然，掀起更为猛烈的讨论。
但李毅充耳不闻，再次取出三支箭，弯弓搭箭，对着天空中的目标。
箭斗术！
有了二连射加箭斗术的结合，将三连射与箭斗术结合在一起，对于此时的李毅而言，易如反掌。
只见在箭斗术的加持下，三箭瞬间射出，在半空中分向不同的目标，须臾间就将三个目标命中。
“什么？这是什么箭术！？”
一旁的张林，看着这一幕，心中大惊。
三连射这种强大射术，他也曾经见过一位箭道天才施展过，但是这三发齐射还能让箭分别命中不同的目标，这实在是骇人听闻！
根本就不符合常理啊！
这已经不是天才，是怪物了！
张林浑身发寒，但是想到曹立的吩咐，咬了咬牙，心中瞬间有了决定。
曹立司马早就下了命令，若是完不成，后果不堪设想。
一想到那后果，张林目光一凝，旋即浑身气血宛如沸水般，在体内疯狂涌动。
刹那间，张林的手臂上血管暴起，手中的五石弓瞬间拉满，二连射接连不断的射出，瞬间化作一片箭雨，将面前的一片鸟雀击杀。
原本张林的速度，就比李毅快，但是现在，张林射箭的手甚至拉出了残影，远远胜过了李毅。
“这张林不要命了吗？居然施展出爆血这种秘法！”
一旁观战的吴川生，瞬间就认出，张林这是施展了呼吸法中的秘法，将自身的力量等提升到了一个不属于当前境界的层次。

这虽然会短时间内增加战力，但是也会对身体造成极大的伤害。
先前卖给李毅破军弓的那个老张头，就是因为施展秘法，导致双手经脉受损，再也拉不了弓了。
不然以他的箭术，就算是腿瘸了，也依然会是一个强大的弓箭手！
不至于落魄退役，隐居在甜水巷中终日以酒度日。
张林的异样，并没有引起李毅的注意。
此时的李毅，陷入了一种天地间唯我的一种境地。
拉弓，射箭，拉弓，射箭……
在李毅的意识中，此刻他只有这几个念头。
考核的输赢，户曹与曹立的胁迫等，都被李毅抛之脑后。
若是有懂行的人，便能一眼认出，此时的李毅已经进入了顿悟的状态。
在一次次射箭中，李毅只觉得这破军弓，不再是弓，而是自己的手，腰间的箭，不再是箭，而是自己的手指。
弓与箭，在这一刻与李毅浑然一体。
人箭合一！
这是一种极高的箭术境界。
若是李毅在这一刻打开技能面板，便会看见自己的射箭技能，经验值一直在增长。
不知道过了多久，久到大营内只有李毅的射箭声，再不半点杂音。
“空了？”
将手伸向腰间的李毅，扑了个空。
箭壶中的箭没了？
李毅心神回转，只见箭壶中的箭已经射完，而在面前，洒落着无数抽搐的鸟雀。

再转眼一望，只见张林脸庞通红，双手止不住地颤抖。
“你没事吧？”
content_en:
"What? It was actually a three-shot burst!?"
"What kind of monster is this?"
"And this kind of archery?"
The onlookers were instantly in an uproar, sparking an even more intense discussion.
But Li Yi turned a deaf ear and took out three arrows again, bent his bow and pointed them at the target in the sky.
Archery fighting!
With the combination of two consecutive shots and arrow fighting skills, it is easy for Li Yi to combine three consecutive shots with arrow fighting skills at this time.
With the blessing of archery fighting skills, three arrows were shot out instantly, flying towards different targets in mid-air, and hitting the three targets in an instant.
"What? What kind of archery is this!?"
Zhang Lin on the side was shocked when he saw this scene.
He had once seen a powerful archery technique such as three consecutive shots performed by an archery genius, but these three salvos could also make the arrows hit different targets. This was really shocking!
It’s totally against common sense!
This is no longer a genius, but a monster!
Zhang Lin felt chills all over, but thinking of Cao Li's instructions, he gritted his teeth and made an instant decision in his heart.
Cao Li Sima had already given the order, and if it could not be completed, the consequences would be disastrous.
When he thought of the consequences, Zhang Lin's eyes froze, and immediately the energy and blood all over his body surged crazily in his body like boiling water.
In an instant, the blood vessels in Zhang Lin's arms bulged, and the five-stone bow in his hand was instantly fully drawn. Two shots were fired one after another, instantly turning into a rain of arrows, killing the birds in front of him.
Zhang Lin was originally faster than Li Yi, but now, Zhang Lin's archery hand even pulled out the afterimage, far surpassing Li Yi.
"Is this Lin desperate for his life? He actually used the secret technique of exploding blood!"
Wu Chuansheng, who was watching the battle from the sidelines, instantly recognized that Zhang Lin had used the secret method of breathing to raise his own strength to a level that was not part of his current state.
Although this will increase combat power in a short period of time, it will also cause great harm to the body.
The old Zhangtou who had previously sold Li Yi Pojun Bow had damaged the meridians in his hands due to the use of secret techniques, and could no longer pull the bow.
Otherwise, with his archery skills, even if he is lame, he will still be a powerful archer!
He would not retire in despair and live in seclusion in Sweet Water Lane drinking all day long.
Zhang Lin's strangeness did not attract Li Yi's attention.
At this time, Li Yi fell into a self-centered situation in the world.
Draw the bow, shoot the arrow, draw the bow, shoot the arrow...
In Li Yi's consciousness, he only had these few thoughts at the moment.
The winning and losing of the assessment, the coercion of Hu Cao and Cao Li, etc. were all forgotten by Li Yi.
Anyone who knows anything can recognize at a glance that Li Yi has entered a state of enlightenment at this time.
In shooting arrows again and again, Li Yi only felt that this broken military bow was no longer a bow, but his own hand, and the arrow on his waist was no longer an arrow, but his own finger.
The bow and arrow are integrated with Li Yi at this moment.
Man and arrow unite!
This is an extremely high level of archery.
If Li Yi opens the skills panel at this moment, he will see that his archery skills and experience points are constantly increasing.
I don't know how long it took, but the only sound in the camp was Li Yi's archery, and there was no other noise.
"Empty?"
Li Yi stretched out his hand to his waist and jumped into the air.
Are there no arrows in the quiver?
Li Yi's mind turned around and saw that the arrows in the arrow pot had been shot out, and there were countless twitching birds scattered in front of him.
Looking around again, I saw Zhang Lin's face was red and his hands were shaking uncontrollably.
"Are you okay?"
